result.title: Extending Aircraft Coverage of the Poll Schumann Model Using Public Data
result.summary: The Poll Schumann model requires airframe and engine parameters, but published tables cover only part of the fleet. Applications must obtain missing parameters, substitute another aircraft type or exclude unrepresented types. We reconstruct parameters using geometry from certification documents and manufacturer manuals, together with ICAO engine records. Published equations supply the physical parameters, regression estimates the propulsion efficiency scale. The inventory covers 90 type designators, including 22 absent from the direct pycontrails table and 18 without a listed substitute. Across 68 types, mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) against pycontrails was 7.38% for drag and 3.14% for design Mach. Across 66 types in 21 families, efficiency regression achieved 3.91% MAPE with the evaluated family excluded from input selection and fitting. On 100 recorded A320 flights, a type already represented in the published tables, cruise fuel flow MAPE for reconstructed and published parameter sets was 4.50% versus 4.68%, while mean absolute percentage error in integrated fuel over covered airborne intervals was 7.19% versus 6.82%. Public technical records can therefore extend Poll Schumann parameter coverage, with quantified agreement against published coefficients and comparable fuel prediction errors on the evaluated A320 flights.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文利用认证文件、厂商手册中的几何信息与 ICAO 发动机记录，重建 Poll Schumann 模型所需的机型与发动机参数，扩展机型覆盖范围，并用 pycontrails 已发布系数和 A320 实际航班燃油流量加以校验。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于航空排放与燃油建模的参数补全工作，不涉及视觉或多模态推理中的内部表示、证据筛选与停止决策，也未提供可供迁移的推理状态或训练监督线索。
